issue.title: Move deferred Pomodoro Task Link descendants with their parent bullet
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-1m.2 while landing epic bob-cli-1m. Verified independently on bob-plugins master at 66d97cc. A deferred hash-marked Pomodoro Task Link is moved into the follow-on Pomodoro, but its descendant note subtree remains under the closed Pomodoro. This predates bob-cli-1m and was explicitly out of scope. Fix buildPomodoroCompletionPlan to move the whole descendant subtree with the link, preserve source order and cursor accounting, add focused regression coverage, bump task-status-cycler, and deploy.

task_type_fields.impact: Ctrl+Enter leaves work notes orphaned one indentation level too deep under the closed Pomodoro instead of preserving them with the deferred Task Link in the new Pomodoro.
task_type_fields.repro: On current bob-plugins master, pass lines containing an open Pomodoro, a direct child deferred link line ending in #, and a deeper descendant note into buildPomodoroCompletionPlan. The returned edits remove only the direct link line; no edit removes or relocates the descendant, while copiedBulletLines contains only the link.

payload.description: Both fixes change Pomodoro carry-forward planning and classification; coordinate tests and manifest bump if worked concurrently.
